concerns.text: T016b (Implement runner logic) is marked as incomplete `[ ]` but T057a (Fix Timeout & Partial State Saving) and T016c (Verification) depend on it. T057a is marked `[X]` (complete) despite depending on an incomplete task. This creates a semantic ordering violation where a consumer (T057a) is marked complete before its producer (T016b) exists.

T016c depends on T016b and T057a. T057a depends on T008c. T016b depends on T057a. This creates a circular dependency: T016b -> T057a -> T016c -> T016b (via T057a). T016b cannot be implemented until T057a is done, but T057a cannot be done until T016b is done. The tasks must be linearized.

T026b (Define configuration loading logic) is marked `[ ]` (incomplete) but T020a (LMM logic) and T020b (Integration) depend on T026a, which in turn depends on T023. T026b is listed as a dependency for T026a in the text description of T026b itself ('Dep: T026a'), creating a self-referential or circular dependency loop within the US2 implementation block.

T034 (Validate results) depends on T006e (Data Flow Verification). T006e is marked `[X]` (complete). However, T006e's description states it ensures data is available for T034. If T006e is complete, T034 should be executable. However, T034 also depends on T034a and T034b. T034a depends on T006a. T034b depends on T006a and T004. The chain is valid, but T034 is marked `[X]` while T034a and T034b are also `[X]`. The issue is T034 depends on T062 (SC-006 Verification) which is `[X]`, but T062 depends on T066 (Bootstrapped CI) which is `[X]`. The real issue is T034 depends on T033a, T033b, T033c which are `[X]`, but T033 (Report Generation) depends on T034. This is a circular dependency: T033 -> T034 -> T033a/b/c -> T033. T033 cannot be generated before T034 is validated, but T034 validation is part of the report generation flow.

T070 (Streaming Chunk Alignment) is marked `[ ]` (incomplete) and depends on T018b (Streaming Loader, `[X]`) and T026b (Config Loading, `[ ]`). T018b claims to implement the logic to meet target steps, but T070 is the verification task. If T018b is complete, T070 should be the next step. However, T070 is blocked by T026b which is incomplete. This is a valid dependency chain, but the status of T026b blocks the verification of T018b.

T071 (Permutation Test Reproducibility) depends on T067 (Permutation Test, `[X]`) and T030b (Latency Calc, `[X]`). T067 is marked complete, but T071 is the task to ensure reproducibility of T067. If T067 is complete without T071, the reproducibility requirement (Constitution Principle I) is violated. T071 should precede or be part of T067's completion criteria, not a dependent task that can be left incomplete while T067 is marked done.

T072 (Partial State Integrity) depends on T057 (Time-Bound Baseline Validation, `[ ]`) and T016c (Verification, `[ ]`). T057 and T016c are incomplete. T072 is also incomplete. This is a valid chain, but the entire US1 verification block (T057, T016c, T072) is incomplete, blocking the final report generation (T033) which depends on T034 (Physics Validation) which depends on T006e (Data Flow, `[X]`). The data flow is marked complete, but the validation of the partial state (T057) is not, creating a semantic gap.

T016b and T016c descriptions are redundant. T016b says 'Implement runner logic... to execute... for a minimum of target_steps'. T016c says 'Implement logic... to verify the step count is reached'. These should be merged or T016c should be a test task, not an implementation task, to avoid confusion in the dependency graph.
